measure: The analysis pipeline, wired by hand: RepositoryValidator, the selected roots in MAIN, GENERATED, TEST order, a fresh cache, one RUNNING analysis, then SpoonModelBuilder.analyze with a StructureExtractor over an ElementWriter; every row is read back from code_element, dependency, dependency_evidence, module_dependency, source_file and source_root after end(), edges are DependencyAggregator.aggregate over the rows read back, and the writes are observed by a StructureSink that wraps the ElementWriter and reads each table's max(id) after every accept. A second, untimed pass over the same batches times the two per-unit functions and counts the excluded constructs. It also records StructureExtractor.resolutionCounts() checked against the rows, the ambiguous rows, to_method_pk, the external rows split by ExternalPackages and fanOutExternal with and without the denylist, all read back; also the bare external targets split by first letter, the external targets in the source's own package and the JDK targets of a module outside the jlink image, from the same rows

selections.DEFAULT: MAIN and GENERATED, no TEST: the analysis default and spoon-corpus.json's population

environment.storage: APPLE SSD AP1024Z internal NVMe SSD
environment.runtime: full JDK under Maven Surefire, not the jlink image the application ships
